name: Concierge
description: Natural-language search for your Jellyfin library — describe a film and find it, including by the lines spoken in it.
overview: Search your library the way you'd describe a film to a friend.

versions.changelog: The Concierge toggle is now an icon in the search box, in the corner Jellyfin Enhanced's Jellyseerr icon used, and that icon is hidden by a setting you can untick. Fixes the search bar doing nothing since 0.18.0.0 — a stray brace was a syntax error that killed the client script on load. Re-index a single item on any model with thinking on or off for that call only, and forget its dialogue when a subtitle track was extracted in the wrong language. Thinking is set per pass. Warns when enrichment has been paid for but not embedded. Folds in 0.19.0.0 through 0.23.0.0.

The search row is called Matches, sits above every other result row, and says whether it is searching or ranking. Concierge mode gives the whole page over to your own library at a toggle. The settings page is tabbed, with which-model-runs-which-pass leading the Models tab. Skeleton cards, a light sweep while the model ranks, and cards that slide into their ranked positions. Match reason length, how many results get one, and the wait before a paid search are all settings now. Folds in 0.14.0.0 through 0.17.0.0.

Results appear in about a millisecond: the free keyword answer paints immediately and the ranked one replaces it when it lands, so nothing waits on the model to show something real. Posters render, the row uses Jellyfin's own horizontal card shape, EnableThinking finally takes effect on OpenAI, and the result count is the model's judgement rather than a fixed twelve. Folds in 0.11.0.0 through 0.12.0.0.

Results reach the Jellyfin search box as poster cards, above the Jellyseerr rows. Fixes an upgrade that silently did nothing — the client script URL never changed between releases and carried no cache headers, so browsers kept running the old one. Folds in 0.10.0.0.

Everything before the search box: natural-language search over your library from the plugin's own page. Hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, an enrichment pass that writes what each item is about, a plan pass that reads constraints out of a sentence, quote search over your own subtitles and lyrics, checkpointing so a cancelled index build loses nothing, and an append-only monthly query log with per-call costs. Folds in 0.2.0.0 through 0.8.0.0.
